name: infranodus-memory
description: InfraNodus Graph Memory: memory for Claude Code, stored as a knowledge graph in your InfraNodus account. Its commands recall, save and optimize what was learned about a project through your InfraNodus connector. With an optional API key it also works by itself: at the end of a session it saves what was learned, and at the first prompt of the next one it recalls it, plus a gap the memory doesn't cover yet. Recall is GraphRAG: it follows the graph's links between concepts by hop distance instead of matching text. /infranodus-memory:off stops it for one project.

api_key.title: InfraNodus API key (optional)
api_key.description: Optional. Turns on automatic memory (recall at session start, saving at session end). Without it, use the skills through the InfraNodus connector.

save.title: What to save (optional)
save.description: both (the default: learnings about each project, and facts about clients, companies and cases, each in its own memory-<topic> graph), learnings, or memories.

exclude_paths.title: Folders to leave out (optional)
exclude_paths.description: Comma-separated folders or globs where memory never runs, e.g. ~/clients/*, ~/private
